summary: This is an 8-K filed by Vista Credit Strategic Lending Corp. reporting the unregistered sale of 262,781 shares of its Class I and Class S common stock for total consideration of ~$5.05M, finalized on May 21, 2026. The sales were made under subscription agreements, exempt under Section 4(a)(2) and Regulation D/S. Item 8.01 also discloses a preliminary NAV/share of $19.21 as of April 30, 2026. There is no acquisition, divestiture, tender offer, activist campaign, strategic review, going-private, spin-off, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, or other special-situation event. This is a routine capital raise and NAV update, consistent with normal operations for a BDC, not a special situation.
